    Pathways

    Shift tools

    A discharge safety check built from the department's rules and Million Ringgit Habits, and the calculators, built from the ebook, the department's notes and the national CPGs. Nothing you tick or type is saved.

    Calculators

    Doses, scores and checks built only from the ebook, the department's notes and the national CPGs, each naming its source. Where a source stops, the calculator says so. Nothing you type is saved.

    No calculator matches. Try a drug, a score or a condition.

    Numbers to know

    The department's extensions by room, then the numbers to know. Copy a number, or open the rule it belongs to. Check extensions against the current department directory before you rely on them.

    ED links

    The department's forms, hospital systems and folders from the ETD HKL link page, sorted for a shift. Hospital systems open only on the hospital network; most forms need your MOH Google account. Nothing here is stored.

    Left out on purpose: the link page's response registers (Google Sheets that may hold patients' details). Open them from the link page itself.

    ED dosing and dilution guide

    The department's own guide to the injectable drugs used in the ED: find a drug, then open its pages as printed, with the dose, dilution, rate and nursing notes. Nothing here is stored.

    ED pharmacy drug list

    What the Emergency Pharmacy supplies, as its own list prints it, with each drug's prescriber category in the MOH Medicines Formulary. Find a drug before you write it on a discharge prescription. Nothing here is stored.

        What's new in the guide

        Every round since the version 8 redesign of 8 Nov 2026, newest first. Below them, what came in from the MO Drive and the triage course folder, what did not and why, and what is still to confirm.

        The wall poster

        Two A3 sheets for the Green Zone wall: the patient flow, rules and numbers on the first, and the pathways, EMACC, Asthma Zone and referrals on the second. Tap a sheet to read it full size. With night colours on, you see the night versions; the sheets on the wall keep the day colours.

        Sources and about

        Everything in this guide and where it comes from. It is a reference tool only and holds no patient data. Use clinical judgement and consult the Emergency Physician on duty when unsure.

        Privacy

        No patient data is entered or stored. Saved and recent pathways, the quiz score, your settings, the intro and where you stopped the tour stay in this browser only, and you can clear them in Settings. Nothing you tick in the safety check or type in the calculators is kept.

        Voice search uses your browser's own speech service, and Ask in your own words (in the claude.ai copy) sends your question to Claude under your own account: say or type a topic, never a patient's name or details. A patient's QR code holds only the address of the advice, and the patient's page keeps nothing about them. A report from Something wrong on this step? goes only where you send it.

        Illustrations and clips are generated artwork and show no real staff or patients. Department documents are cited by title and date; personal phone numbers, registration numbers and patient details in them are left out.

        Share the guide

        Send the guide to a colleague: one link opens it on any phone. Nothing here is stored, and nothing is sent unless you send it.

        Install the guide

        Put the guide on your home screen or desktop. It opens like an app, full screen, and works without a signal: on ward Wi-Fi, on mobile data or with none at all.

        Reference tool only. Pathways follow The Clinical Pathway in Emergency for Medical Officer, Emergency & Trauma Department, Hospital Kuala Lumpur (2025), as written, and page numbers refer to that edition. Green Zone rules and department protocols follow the memos, SOPs and notes in the department's drives, with each source and date named on its entry.

        Use clinical judgement and consult the Emergency Physician on duty when unsure. Version 8.
